# dsh-plugins

Community plugins for DeepSeek Harness
(`dsh`) — one independently versioned npm package per plugin.
English | 中文

> Not affiliated with DeepSeek. `dsh` and DeepSeek Harness are the platform;
> this repository ships
community extensions for it.
## Why this repository

- **Install one plugin, update one plugin.** Each package has its own version,
changelog, git tag, G

itHub Release, and npm artifact. Nothing else moves.
- **Shared code, not copy-paste.** Cross-plugin

helpers live once in
`@codeasier/dsh-plugin-kit` and are compiled into each
plugin at build time, s

o every published tarball installs on its own.
- **Conventions are executable.** A generator scaffol

ds new plugins, and CI
checks manifests, row ids, locales, icons, docs links, and the real
`npm pack

ns, and CI
checks manifests, row ids, locales, icons, docs links, and the real
`npm pack` file list.
## Plugins
| Plugin | What it adds | Version |
| `@codeasier/dsh-plugin-hello` | A minimal, production-shaped DeepSeek Harness plugin: one configur
able tool, display metadata, and independent release wiring. | `0.1.0` |

Each plugin's README documents its behavior, configuration, and tested
compatibility. The shared kit

is a source library compiled into each plugin, not
a bundle, so it is not listed above.

### DeepSeek Harness Desktop

Open **Plugins** in the Desktop window, or use the command runtime bundled with
the app. The npm `ds

h` CLI intentionally cannot manage the Electron-owned
`desktop` profile.
Detailed steps: CLI · Desktop.
## How it fits together

A DSH profile is an ordered list of bundles plus a patch layer. A plugin is an
npm package that decl

ares `dsh.bundle.patch`; installing it selects the bundle,
and its patch inserts a Loader row. The p

lugin's host half runs in-process;
an optional client half is served to the Web UI and Desktop from

Read Architecture for the full model, and
Plugin anatomy for the code-level contract.
## Develop

Requires Node `>=22.18.0` and pnpm 11. The integration steps also need DSH
`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`.

| `pnpm test` | Run every package's Vit

est suite. |
| `pnpm typecheck` | Type-check without emitting. |
| `pnpm lint` / `pnpm lint:fix` | B

iome check / apply safe fixes. |
| `pnpm check` | Full gate: lint, types, tests, build, conventions,

docs, packs. |
| `pnpm new <name>` | Scaffold a plugin and update the catalog. |
| `pnpm changeset`

| Record a release note. |

rd a release note. |

| Plugins | DeepSeek Harness | Node.js |

## Security

Plugins execute in the DSH process with your user's permissions; there is no
plugin sandbox. Install

reviewed releases, prefer exact versions, and never put
secrets in profile configuration. Report vu

lnerabilities through GitHub's
private advisory flow — see SECURITY.md.
